items.title: Amazon EC2 X8i instances are now available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region
items.content_snippet: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) X8i instances are available in the Asia Pacific (New Zealand) Region. X8i instances are SAP-certified and deliver the highest performance and fastest memory bandwidth among comparable Intel processors in the cloud. items.title: AWS Sign-In introduces configurable Sign-in duration of up to 90 days
items.content_snippet: AWS Sign-In now enables developers and AI agents to stay authenticated for up to 90 days without frequent sign-ins or consent prompts. items.title: AWS WAF introduces simplified pricing
items.content_snippet: AWS WAF now offers simplified pricing that follows what you protect instead of how you configure it. Previously, you paid separate charges for each web ACL, rule, rule group subscription, and capacity tier, making every security decision a billing calculation. Now, your bill follows three dimensions: the resources you protect, the traffic AWS WAF inspects, and the level of protection you apply. items.title: How to Search for Exoplanets
items.content_snippet: Two amateur astronomers, Kevin Bond and Ethan Byrd, independently found signals that could point to planets around distant stars. They knew you didn't need your own telescope for this kind of hunt. Kevin used Codex and Ethan used Astra to search public telescope data for tiny, recurring dips in starlight that an orbiting planet can cause. Both found signals worth a second look. https://openai.com/index/searching-for-distant-planets-with-astra/
